mostWorthwhile.text: Following liquid sweat into evaporation was most worthwhile: the planned humid-air comparison distinguishes producing sweat from actually cooling the body.

leastWorthwhile.text: Producing liquid sweat felt somewhat predictable on its own, although it set up the more informative evaporation step.

surprise.text: The explicit distinction between narrowing vessels to conserve heat and shivering to produce it sharpened my understanding of the cold response.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the signals and targets made each response plausible. Compatibility was offered, though, so these choices did not test whether I could discover the pairings.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose to continue: the contrasting responses and feedback made the physiological connections interesting, though the offered combinations made the decisions fairly straightforward.
